name: Scrap Mechanic GP0 analysis corpus
description: Selective capture policy for SMML GP0. The archive is for private static analysis, hook/content mapping and diff work; it is not a redistribution package.

path_rules.reason: Official example mods/templates are compact and directly document supported content/mod structures.
Small installation metadata useful for installation/build analysis.
Runtime output. Relevant experiment logs should be captured separately and intentionally.
Generated cache. Preserve metadata/hashes/names, not bulk content.
Native runtime binaries are outside the initial Lua/data modding scope. Preserve metadata and hashes only.

FULL.reason: Scripts, registries, declarative databases/configuration, small text formats and OBJ collision/geometry sources are directly useful to Hook Patcher and Content Composer analysis.

SAMPLE.reason: Useful format/schema/asset examples, but full families are repetitive or too large for the compact GP0 corpus.

REFERENCE.reason: Generated caches, compiled/native binaries, large binary runtime assets or compiled counterparts. Metadata and hashes are sufficient for initial GP0 analysis.

selection: prefer one file from each top-level root when available
prefer both likely-text and likely-binary variants when an extension has both
never sample Cache/ or Release/ unless a future policy explicitly overrides them
